chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no objection to a man offering salat over the deceased after he has been buried.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection; it is permissible
key_terms.ٱلرَّجُلُ: the man; the person performing the prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat over a deceased person after burial?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that performing salat over the deceased is permissible even after burial. It indicates flexibility in the timing of the funeral prayer when it was not performed before burial.
